_about: A deliberately small common format for assets and findings. Modeled loosely on OCSF (no OCSF spec is attached, so these are our names, not OCSF field names). SAFE's internal data model would replace this file.

asset.asset_id: Our id for the merged asset
asset.display_name: Device name a person gave it (identity tools)
asset.last_seen: Most recent time any tool saw the asset

finding.finding_id: Source tool's id for the finding
finding.asset_ref: Source tool's id for the affected asset or project
finding.title: Short title
finding.severity: Severity as the source reports it
finding.status: Open, fixed, ignored, etc. as the source reports it
